reviews.title: Why??
reviews.text:
Q: Why would people PAY YOU for YOU to STORE their personal life, information, data, etc?? 
A: So they can sell it or use it after you cancel trial or subscription or if you stop using it or wait statute of limitations so that they can make billions off others by extorting people! 
I could not leave a review unless I downloaded this app and then I immediately deleted, without opening. For about a minute I was in love w the idea of the app! THEN. I was reading the permissions n such and are you kidding me?!?! I’m not paying YOU so that u can make money by selling information after statute of limitations! lol that is extortion no matter how you defend that it is not.

reviews.title: PREVIOUS TITLE - forever one of my favorite apps
reviews.text:
UPDATE: i suppose all good things must come to an end… it is now very distinctly a “freemium” app, with a cost that increases with the number of journals you have—since i raved so much about the app, i had tons of journals, and the unlimited tier is more than i can afford. none of my friends or family or coworkers are willing to pay that much either, so unfortunately we no longer use the app. i’d give it zero stars if i could.

 i’ve tried a LOT of journaling apps… probably 97% of the free ones 😅 this is by far THE best one, for so many reasons. i love the concept of a shared journal—i had been keeping a shared note with my friend, but it wasn’t really as efficient as i thought it would be. my mom and i used to have this tiny mailbox that we would leave notes in for each other, and this is exactly that. now that we no longer live together, this is perfect. it’s simple to use, even she can figure it out 😂 it’s beautifully designed and works perfectly. i honestly can’t believe how lovely it is, and it doesn’t even have any ads! there’s no “catch,” this isn’t one of those “freemium” apps that ultimately require a purchase to be any good. that said, now that i have had the privilege of experiencing the app, i’m actually more willing to pay a little to help support them than if i had been forced to do it in order to fully enjoy the app’s features. sato, the developer, is so incredibly nice and uses feedback to immediately improve the app. i love that i’m able to text him for any (app-related) support needed; i work all day, and texting is SO much more convenient than trying to navigate an online form or finding the time for a phone call. overall, i love how waffle allows me to stay in the loop about my friends’ and family’s lives. i work crazy hours and i don’t want to wake people up when i get home at 3 in the morning, but i love to read about their day and the little things they couldn’t share while i was working, or give my thoughts on something when they ask for advice. i also like to share a funny story from work or leave a picture of my cat 😁 it’s really nice that there’s no pressure to write out long entries cataloging every detail of the day; you can interact with it when you have the time and energy, instead of feeling obligated to answer a text right away. and for the days when you want to reach out but just don’t know what to talk about, there is even a list of prompts to choose from!!! this is genuinely one of the best apps i’ve ever had and will stay on my phone forever. thank you sato! 🧇

reviews.title: Freezes during signup and you lose everything.
reviews.text: I thought this would be great for me and my daughter. I signed up. Did the free trial. Created a journal. Sent her the code. Went to enter a password to create account and it froze. Had to hard shut down the app and start again from the beginning. Did it all again, sent her a new code, and the thing crashed again when I tapped in the password field. I deleted the app and cancelled the subscription. This is basic user testing and regression testing that failed and made me not trust their app. Ask for the info upfront so all that progress isn’t lost or fix your flow.

reviews.title: Underwhelmed
reviews.text: I really thought this would be something at least appearing to herniate of deeper conversation/emotions/memories/growth anything at all but it’s just basic questions reframed to day, week, month timelines and a smattering of “what was the best/worst of your past from a certain topic you want to share” really? We haven’t gotten past that level yet? Do you even know each other if you haven’t answered those basic questions?  The whole point is to offer another perspective into each other as individuals and how you come together… maybe this is better suited to people who need help just asking the basic getting to know you questions but if you’ve been in a relationship with anyone for a while and had all of the talks you normally would, this isn’t going to help you at all.
